chart.title: AI share of US job postings

rows.indicator: AI-cited layoff announcements, share of total cuts

rows.note: Recent-grad (22–27 BA+) minus overall unemployment rate, 12mma

meta.exposure_source: Eloundou et al. (2023) beta, human+GPT-4 mean, via OCC2010

quintile_shares.title: Employment share by AI-exposure quintile
quintile_shares.source: CPS basic monthly microdata (IPUMS); exposure: Eloundou et al. (2023)
quintile_shares.note: Each quintile holds ~20% of 2022 employment. A falling line means that quintile is shrinking as a share of all jobs.

recent_grad.title: Recent-graduate unemployment gap
recent_grad.note: Recent grads = ages 22–27 with a bachelor's or higher. Historically they track the overall rate; a widening gap is the canary.

wage_growth.title: Median weekly earnings growth by AI-exposure quintile
wage_growth.source: CPS outgoing rotation groups (IPUMS); exposure: Eloundou et al. (2023)
wage_growth.note: Usual weekly earnings, wage and salary workers. Smoothed twice (median then 12mma), so turns show up late but cleanly.

diffusion.title: Exposed-occupation diffusion index (working name)
diffusion.units: % of occupations losing jobs over the past year, employment-weighted
diffusion.source: CPS basic monthly microdata (IPUMS); exposure: Eloundou et al. (2023)
diffusion.note: Share of top-exposure-quintile occupations (≥50k workers in 2022) with 12-month-average employment below its year-earlier level. Above ~50, decline is the norm, not the exception.

adoption.title: Firms using AI (Census BTOS)
adoption.source: Census Business Trends and Outlook Survey — hand-entered; automation planned
adoption.empty_msg: Awaiting first manual BTOS entry — see manual.json.

buildout.title: Data-center construction spending
buildout.source: Census Value of Construction Put in Place (C30)
buildout.stat_label: contribution of info-processing equipment + software investment to GDP growth, 2026Q2

markets.title: AI basket vs. the rest of the market
markets.source: Yahoo Finance daily adjusted closes; S&P 493 = S&P 500 ex–Mag 7, anchored to SPY holdings weights (SSGA)
markets.stat_label: Mag 7 share of S&P 500 market cap

productivity.title: Labor productivity vs. pre-AI trend
productivity.source: BLS nonfarm business output per hour (via FRED); trend fit 2015–19

gdp_contrib_series.title: AI-related investment contribution to GDP growth
gdp_contrib_series.units: percentage points of annualized quarterly growth
gdp_contrib_series.source: BEA NIPA via FRED: info-processing equipment + software contributions
